notes.neural_routing_parallel_track: mcp_neural_launch_routing_migration_b254_v1 provides neural curriculum for learned adapter selection. The B276 spec keeps static adapter mapping as safety floor; the neural router should eventually replace static dispatch.
notes.deepseek_manual_adapter: DeepSeek runs as a separate chat session initiated by the owner. The MCP can prepare the command block but cannot spawn a DeepSeek process locally. This is by design, not a gap.
notes.completion_inbox_integration: B275 completion_inbox wiring already provides review_queue, stale_processing, and runner_mismatch_warnings. The autolaunch completion path (section 4 of B276 spec) builds directly on these existing read-only tools.
